name: Munnar
description: A hill station in Kerala known for rolling tea estates, cool weather, misty viewpoints and waterfalls. Easy-paced and family-friendly, with a mix of gentle sightseeing and light trekking.

attractions.name: KDHP Tea Museum
attractions.description: A working museum tracing Munnar's tea history, with a demonstration of tea processing and a tasting. Mostly indoors — a good rainy-day option.

attractions.name: Mattupetty Dam
attractions.description: A scenic concrete dam and reservoir surrounded by hills, popular for speed-boating and photos. Gentle walking only.

attractions.name: Echo Point
attractions.description: A lakeside spot where shouts echo off the surrounding hills. Quick stop with nice valley views; can get crowded and noisy midday.

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai)
attractions.description: A protected park famous for the endangered Nilgiri Tahr and sweeping grassland-and-cloud views. Involves a shuttle bus plus a moderate uphill walk; book early as entry is limited.

attractions.name: Top Station
attractions.description: Munnar's highest viewpoint on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border, looking over the Western Ghats. Often wrapped in mist; the drive itself is scenic.

attractions.name: Kundala Lake
attractions.description: A calm dam-fed lake on the way to Top Station, offering pedal- and shikara-boating amid hills. Relaxed and senior-friendly.
